content: React current stable is 19.3; Vite 8.3 is the current supported line and has official react-ts scaffolding. The app is a browser-only SPA, so React with TypeScript and Vite is enough; React docs deprecated Create React App and recommend frameworks or build tools such as Vite for new client apps. Sources: https://react.dev/versions https://react.dev/blog https://vite.dev/guide/ https://vite.dev/releases
